subject: Television & Streaming
title: Interactive and Choose-Your-Own Storytelling
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Interactive and Choose-Your-Own Storytelling.

hook.text: Black Mirror: Bandersnatch let viewers make choices that changed the story.

buildup.text: Interactive storytelling requires exponentially more writing.

discovery.text: Bandersnatch contained over 150 minutes of unique footage. Most viewers saw only about 90 minutes.

twist.text: Interactive TV hasn't caught on widely. The effort of choosing exhausts viewers who watch television to be passive.

climax.text: Interactive storytelling may not replace traditional TV, but it expanded what television can be.

punchline.text: Television offered viewers control. Viewers preferred the couch.

quiz.question: Why hasn't interactive television storytelling become mainstream despite Bandersnatch's success?
options: Most viewers prefer passive consumption and find the effort of making choices exhausting
